* Identify and catalog service accounts, machine identities, and AI identities across client environments; document ownership, usage, and risk for discovered NHI.
* Support NHI lifecycle processes, including creation, ownership assignment, credential rotation, and decommissioning.
* Help discover and govern cloud workload identities, including AWS IAM roles, Azure Managed Identities, and GCP service accounts.
* Apply secrets-management practices using dedicated vaulting platforms.
* Implement security controls for NHI, including vaulting concepts and privileged handling where applicable.
* Develop remediation plans for unmanaged or unvaulted service accounts and machine identities.
* Participate in current-state analysis, stakeholder discovery, and requirements gathering for identity programs; contribute to future-state roadmaps and remediation recommendations.

* 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, or supporting NHI, PAM, or vaulting solutions.

* Comfort contributing to current-state analysis and roadmap development for identity programs.
* Awareness of how NHI fits within broader identity governance and IAM programs.

* Comfort working in large, multi-application environments with a high volume of service accounts.
* Relevant identity or security certifications.

### **What success looks like**

* NHI discovery produces a documented inventory of in-scope service accounts, machine identities, and AI identities.
* Unvaulted accounts, ownerless service accounts, and stale machine identities are identified, prioritized, and handed off with remediation steps.
* Assessment deliverables give clients a clear picture of current state and a roadmap for improving their identity program.

Role Purpose  
Centrica is looking for an experienced WalkMe Process Developer to support the design, development and continuous improvement of digital adoption solutions across enterprise applications and business processes.  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, process owners, product teams, change teams and technology specialists to understand user journeys, identify areas of friction and develop effective WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) solutions that improve user experience, process compliance, productivity and adoption.  
The WalkMe Process Developer will translate business processes and user requirements into intuitive in application guidance, automation and contextual support, helping users complete activities correctly and efficiently while reducing dependency on traditional training and manual support.  
  
The role requires a combination of WalkMe development, process analysis, user experience thinking, testing, analytics and stakeholder management capability.  
  
  
  
Certifications – Desirable  
Relevant certifications would be advantageous, particularly:  
  
. WalkMe Digital Adoption Technical Certification  
. WalkMe Builder / Developer certifications  
. WalkMe Project Management or Solution Architecture certifications  
. Change Management certification  
. Lean / Process Improvement certification  
  
Certification should complement, rather than replace, strong hands on WalkMe development experience.  
Key Competencies  
WalkMe DevelopmentAble to independently design, build, test and maintain high quality WalkMe solutions.  
Process ThinkingUnderstands the underlying business process rather than simply adding guidance to application screens.  
User Centred DesignDesigns digital adoption experiences around what users need to successfully complete their work.  
Analytical ThinkingUses adoption and behavioural data to identify problems and measure whether solutions are effective.  
Problem SolvingAble to troubleshoot complex WalkMe behaviour and application interaction issues.  
Stakeholder ManagementComfortable working directly with business process owners, application teams and transformation stakeholders.  
Continuous ImprovementUses analytics, feedback and changing business requirements to continually improve digital experiences.

. Simplify complex user journeys.  
. Reduce process errors and rework.  
. Improve process compliance.  
. Increase employee productivity.  
. Reduce dependency on traditional training and support.

. Optimise existing WalkMe solutions based on user feedback and analytics.

. Work with UX, Product and Change teams to ensure a consistent employee/user experience.

. Support deployment and release of new WalkMe content.  
  
5. WalkMe Analytics & Insights

. Monitor: Walk Thru usage Process completion Drop off points User engagement Feature adoption Error/failure patterns  
. Analyse user journeys to identify areas where additional guidance or process improvement is required.  
. Establish measurable adoption and success criteria.  
. Provide stakeholders with insights on adoption, usage and business outcomes.  
. Use data to continuously improve WalkMe solutions.  
  
6. WalkMe Editor & Technical Configuration

. Configure element selection and page recognition.  
. Develop robust rules and segmentation.  
. Troubleshoot issues caused by dynamic web page behaviour or application changes.  
. Ensure WalkMe content remains resilient when underlying applications are updated.  
. Apply appropriate technical standards for maintainability and performance.  
. Work with application development teams where technical support is required.  
  
7. JavaScript / CSS / Web Technologies

. Use JavaScript to support advanced WalkMe behaviour.  
. Apply HTML/CSS knowledge to customise presentation and user experience.  
. Understand DOM structures and web application behaviour.  
. Troubleshoot element selection and application compatibility issues.  
. Develop technical solutions without unnecessarily increasing implementation complexity.  
  
8. Testing & Quality Assurance  
  
. Develop and execute test scenarios for WalkMe solutions.

. Business Analysts  
. Change & Transformation teams  
. Learning & Development  
. UX teams  
. Application teams  
. Software Engineers  
. Service Management  
. Security  
. Business users  
  
Facilitate workshops to understand requirements, demonstrate solutions and gather feedback.  
Translate technical WalkMe capabilities into understandable business outcomes for non technical stakeholders.  
10. Change & Transformation Support  
  
. Support major technology and business transformation initiatives through digital adoption.  
. Develop WalkMe content to support new system releases and process changes.  
. Work with Change teams to understand user impact assessments.  
. Provide targeted guidance for affected user groups.  
. Support phased deployments and adoption campaigns.  
. Reduce reliance on classroom training, lengthy manuals and repetitive support activity where contextual guidance provides a better user experience.  
  
11. Governance & Standards  
  
. Follow agreed Centrica digital adoption standards and governance.  
. Maintain reusable WalkMe design patterns and templates.  
. Ensure appropriate naming, documentation and version control standards.  
. Maintain clear ownership of WalkMe content.  
. Establish appropriate review and approval processes.  
. Ensure obsolete guidance is retired when applications or processes change.  
. Contribute to development of WalkMe best practices across the organisation.  
  
12. Security, Privacy & Accessibility  
  
. Ensure WalkMe solutions comply with Centrica security and data protection requirements.  
. Avoid exposing sensitive information through WalkMe content.  
. Apply appropriate user segmentation and access considerations.  
. Ensure digital adoption content meets relevant accessibility requirements.  
. Work with Security and application teams where solutions interact with sensitive processes or data.  
  
13. Continuous Improvement  
  
. Continuously evaluate WalkMe solutions and identify opportunities for optimisation.  
. Use analytics, user feedback and support data to prioritise improvements.  
. Identify opportunities to replace manual guidance with contextual digital assistance.  
. Promote reusable solutions and standards.  
. Stay current with new WalkMe capabilities and digital adoption best practices.  
. Recommend new platform capabilities that could improve employee experience or operational efficiency.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Mandatory Skills & Experience  
The successful candidate should have hands on experience with:

. WalkMe Editor

. SmartTips  
. Launchers

. User segmentation

Help turn technology insight into successful transactions. As an Assistant Director in the Client Technology Transaction Office (CTTO), you will lead technology delivery on assigned transactions across EY’s global business, from diligence and planning through execution, full integration or separation, and transition to ongoing operations. Our remit spans acquisitions, divestitures and separations, intellectual property (IP) assignments and business wind-downs. description:
**About Payoneer**

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

**About Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM)**

Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM) is Payoneer's global workforce solutions business, helping companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage talent anywhere in the world. The business enables organizations to build international teams quickly and compliantly without the need to establish legal entities in every country where they hire.

As remote and distributed workforces become increasingly common, companies face challenges related to employment compliance, payroll, benefits administration, contractor management, and local labor regulations. Payoneer WFM simplifies these complexities through technology-enabled workforce solutions and in-country expertise.

**What We Do:** Payoneer WFM provides end-to-end solutions that help businesses:

* Engage and manage contractors compliantly
* Process global payroll across multiple countries and currencies
* Manage onboarding and offboarding processes
* Ensure compliance with local employment and labor laws
* Handle benefits administration and workforce operations
* Support international expansion without requiring entity setup

Today, Payoneer WFM supports businesses across more than 160 countries, enabling them to access talent globally while maintaining compliance and operational efficiency.

The platform enables businesses to:

* Hire employees and contractors in 160+ countries
* Run global payroll in 70+ currencies
* Manage onboarding, contracts, benefits, compliance, expenses, and offboarding from a single platform
* Navigate local labor laws, tax requirements, and employment regulations across jurisdictions.

Employer of Record (EOR): A key offering within WFM is Employer of Record (EOR). Under the EOR model, Payoneer WFM becomes the legal employer of an individual in their local country while the client company manages the employee's day-to-day responsibilities, goals, and performance.

This allows organizations to hire talent internationally without establishing a local subsidiary or legal entity. Payoneer WFM manages employment contracts, payroll, taxes, statutory benefits, and compliance requirements, enabling clients to focus on growing their business.

Why This Market Matters: The global workforce landscape has changed significantly over the last few years. Companies are increasingly adopting remote and distributed hiring models, allowing them to access talent regardless of geography. As a result, the demand for global employment solutions, international payroll, and compliance management has grown rapidly.

How WFM Fits Within Payoneer: Payoneer is widely recognized as a global financial technology company that enables businesses to send, receive, and manage cross-border payments worldwide. Workforce Management extends this mission by helping businesses not only move money globally but also hire and manage talent globally. Together, these solutions enable companies to build, operate, and scale international businesses more efficiently.

Payoneer WFM is helping redefine how companies build global teams, making international hiring simpler, faster, and more accessible for businesses around the world.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Analyst to support accurate and timely payroll delivery across assigned countries. You will validate payroll inputs, reconcile outputs, resolve discrepancies and coordinate with internal teams and payroll partners. You will also support entity and platform transitions and contribute to automation and AI initiatives that simplify global payroll.

**What you'll do:**

* Support payroll transitions between employing entities, payroll providers or platforms by validating employee data, opening balances and payroll results, and coordinating readiness for the first payroll cycle.
* Coordinate with payroll partners and internal teams to close pending inputs, approvals and discrepancies within agreed timelines, escalating risks that could affect payroll delivery.
* Investigate recurring payroll errors and exceptions, identify root causes and improve validation checks and processes to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain country-specific payroll procedures and support statutory reporting, reconciliations and audits in coordination with local payroll partners.
* Contribute to automation and AI initiatives by identifying manual tasks, documenting payroll requirements, testing workflows and validating outputs, helping us shape the future of Global Payroll

**Who you are:**

* 3-8 years of experience in payroll processing, input validation and reconciliation; exposure to multi-country payroll or payroll partner coordination is an advantage.
* Sound understanding of payroll calculations, tax and statutory requirements for the countries you have supported.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for validating data, reconciling payroll and investigating discrepancies.
* Comfortable working with payroll systems and learning new tools and workflows.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills and the ability to identify risks and resolve problems.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to coordinate across teams, manage competing deadlines and work independently.
* Eager to embrace automation and AI, continuously improve payroll delivery and help shape the future of global payroll.

**How you'll grow**

* Build expertise in multi-country payroll, entity transitions and process improvement while gaining hands-on experience with AI agent-powered workflows.
* Work alongside Product, Engineering and Operations to improve payroll accuracy, reduce manual effort and measure the impact of your contributions.

**Note:** **This role will be part of Payoneer WFM business unit.**

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**

**Act as our customer's partner on the inside**
  
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*

**Do it. Own it.**
  
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*

**Continuously improve**
  
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*

**Build each other up**  
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

  

Hitachi Energy is expanding its Controlling Practice & Operations (CP&O) organization and is seeking talented finance professionals to support our global business units, manufacturing operations, project organizations, product groups, and corporate functions. This opportunity offers exposure to a wide range of finance disciplines including Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Financial Controlling, Business Finance, Manufacturing Finance, Cost Accounting, Project Finance, Commercial Finance, SAP Finance, and Finance Transformation.

As part of a global finance organization, you will partner with business leaders, factory controllers, project managers, commercial teams, product managers, and global stakeholders to provide financial insights that enable informed decision-making and sustainable business growth. You will contribute to planning, forecasting, budgeting, profitability analysis, performance management, project controlling, financial reporting, and governance activities while supporting strategic initiatives across multiple business functions.

The role provides an exceptional opportunity to work in a dynamic international environment where you will collaborate with stakeholders across regions, leverage digital technologies, enhance reporting and analytics capabilities, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. You will support business performance by transforming financial data into meaningful insights, identifying risks and opportunities, and helping leadership teams make data-driven decisions.

Depending on business requirements and experience, successful candidates may contribute across manufacturing finance, project finance, commercial finance, R&D finance, software business controlling, cost accounting, or finance transformation initiatives. This role offers significant exposure to SAP S/4HANA programs, digital finance capabilities, automation initiatives, and global business processes, enabling you to build expertise across diverse finance domains while contributing to Hitachi Energy's mission of advancing a sustainable energy future.

  

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Support budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and financial performance management activities across business units, projects, factories, and functions.
* Analyze business performance against budget, forecast, flash, and actual results, identifying key risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
* Prepare financial reports, KPI dashboards, management presentations, and executive-level insights to support strategic decision-making.
* Perform profitability analysis across products, projects, customers, factories, business units, and functions.
* Monitor and analyze key financial metrics including revenue, gross margin, EBIT, operating expenses, inventory, cash flow, working capital, CAPEX, project profitability, and commercial performance.
* Partner with business leaders, project managers, operations teams, product managers, commercial teams, and global stakeholders to provide financial guidance and recommendations.
* Support manufacturing finance, standard costing, inventory management, cost accounting, project finance, tender finance, and commercial finance activities.
* Contribute to SAP S/4HANA initiatives, reporting automation, digital finance transformation programs, process standardization, and continuous improvement projects.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, internal controls, audit requirements, governance policies, and financial reporting guidelines.
Utilize analytics, Power BI, AI-enabled tools, and automation technologies to improve reporting efficiency, forecasting accuracy, and business performance visibility.

* Skills: Commercial Finance, Product Profitability, Pricing Analysis, Financial Modeling, Forecasting, SAP CO-PA, Power BI, Business Partnering, IFRS 15

**6. Senior R&D Controller**

* Experience: 5-8 Years
* Qualification: CA / CMA / CPA / MBA Finance

**7. FP&A Specialist - Function Transparency**

title: BIM Engineer - Water
description:
* Work as part of WSP’s UK iCRC Water team in Bengaluru.
* Production of high-quality 3D BIM Models in Civil 3D, Revit/PLant 3D.
* Perform variety of 3D CAD modeling assignments under minimal supervision.
* Coordinate with Sr. Design Engineer/ BIM Coordinator/ Design Engineer for the information required to prepare BIM models and generate drawings as per specifications defined by our Client.
* Must have good 3D visualization capabilities.
* Must possess a good ability to work independently/ moderate supervision from BIM Coordinator.
* Collaborate with other designers, engineers, architects and clients to convert information into layout designs, drawings and models using AutoCAD, Civil3D, REVIT/ Plant 3D.
* Decipher information received from various formats (hand sketches, BIM Execution Plans and Architectural drawings).
* Experience within infrastructure especially WTP-WWTP projects is a plus.
* Should be interested and able to work in an international environment.
* Complete other duties as assigned appropriate for the designated grade level.

  

* Good command of written and verbal English.
* Candidate should have a clear and demonstrable technical understanding of standards and norms pertaining to UK Water Industry.
* Problem solving and originality.
* Computer literate, e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
* Successful candidate will be a dynamic, self-motivated individual focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence. The role requires assisting BIM Coordinator and Sr. Design Engineer in managing several projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage. The ability to plan your deliverables against UK engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite and training and guidance will be provided where necessary.
* Cultural awareness, conscientious and an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role.
* Ability to work under pressure and with moderate amount of supervision.
* Accountable and see the big picture of the project to achieve the best result for the client
* Careful and responsible. Understand the concept of working in a team.
* Willingness to travel to the UK for short term assignments and training.
* Strong attention to details and ability to make correct judgements.

  

* Degree/Diploma in Engineering.
* Experience with Civil/ Architectural/ Structural/ Mechanical drawings, developing equipment layout and site plan drawings.
* Experience in leading the modeling related tasks and coordinating with client to get the deliverables completed on schedule and budget.
* Must possess a good working knowledge of core 3D CADD applications (such as Revit, Civil 3D, Plant 3D), as outlined above.
* Must have acceptable knowledge in handling Revit and other BIM application tools and concepts of BIM. Capable of producing Revit plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules etc. must be familiar with all Revit tools and creating and editing view range, drafting views, view templates, system families, materials, project/shared parameters, multi-category schedules, project title blocks, worksets, Revit category-based profile, annotation families etc., must be capable of linking multiple Revit files and work. Capable of handling Revit projects with guidance from superior and managing/ sharing work with others.
* Must be capable of performing Clash detection using Navisworks and Revit interference check, export Clash reports, review clash reports etc.

  + Create Dynamic Blocks with parameters
  + Use different 3D representations such as shading, conceptual etc.
  + Export 3D geometry for use by subcontractors and outside agencies.
  + Assist in the production of 2D sheets (plans, sections, 3D clips and details) from 3D/4D multi-discipline models (Transitional 2D techniques)

  BGV:
* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Lumen is expanding its AI Defense capability and is seeking a hands-on security engineer to help implement, operate, and improve the technologies and processes protecting enterprise AI use, applications, and agents.

This position is part of a four-person, India-based AI Defense team within Investigations & Innovation. The Senior Information Security Engineer will independently perform security engineering, investigations, detection development, threat hunting, platform operations, automation, and control validation within established priorities and delegated authority.

You will investigate suspicious activity, configure security platforms, develop and tune detections, validate protective controls, and maintain repeatable operational procedures. Initial platforms identified for the program include Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS and CrowdStrike Guardian.

You will collaborate with the AI Defense technical lead, contribute to peer reviews and operational improvements, and escalate complex or consequential decisions to AI Defense leadership. The team will coordinate with the Cyber Incident Response Team through established incident response procedures.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot approved AI security platforms, applications, telemetry sources, and integrations.

Monitor platform health, security coverage, and telemetry completeness, identifying and documenting operational gaps.

Investigate security alerts related to employee AI usage, AI applications, and agents, including misuse, policy violations, and suspicious activities.

Investigate prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unauthorized access, and misuse of AI agent tools, identities, and permissions.

Analyze and correlate AI platform, endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application logs to identify affected assets and assess potential impact.

Conduct targeted threat hunting based on emerging threats, suspicious activities, and identified security gaps.

Implement, test, tune, and document security detections, including false-positive analysis and technical limitations.

Execute approved security response procedures, validate outcomes, and escalate issues when necessary.

Develop investigative procedures and seek guidance when existing runbooks do not adequately address identified scenarios.

Document investigations, evidence, affected systems, response actions, and recommended next steps.

Create and maintain runbooks for security investigations, incident response, troubleshooting, and operational handoffs.

Participate in authorized security testing to validate telemetry, detections, security controls, and response workflows.

Develop scripts and API integrations to improve evidence collection, automation, monitoring, and reporting.

Share investigation findings, participate in peer reviews, and recommend improvements to security tools and processes.

Ensure compliance with access-control, privacy, evidence-handling, data-retention, and audit requirements.

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

* **Minimum five years of relevant experience in information technology, cybersecurity, security operations, incident response, detection engineering, security engineering, or a closely related discipline.**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in security operations, incident investigation, detection engineering, threat hunting, or security platform engineering.
* Ability to independently investigate security events, evaluate evidence, document findings, and recognize when escalation is required.
* Experience configuring or troubleshooting enterprise security technologies, integrations, or telemetry sources.
* Experience querying, analyzing, and correlating security telemetry using a SIEM or comparable analytics platform.
* Working knowledge of endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application security.
* Understanding of incident response procedures, evidence preservation, case documentation, and operational handoffs.
* Practical scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, or a comparable language, including experience working with REST APIs and JSON.
* Foundational understanding of AI applications and agents, including prompts, model outputs, retrieval processes, identities, permissions, and tool interactions.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to distinguish verified facts from assumptions.
* Sound judgment when executing approved actions and determining when technical or leadership escalation is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS, CrowdStrike Guardian, or comparable AI security technologies.
* Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon, Palo Alto Networks security platforms, enterprise SIEM technologies, security orchestration, or case-management platforms.
* Experience investigating AI-related threats or conducting authorized validation of AI applications, agents, detections, or protective controls.
* Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, Model Context Protocol, agent identities, agent permissions, and tool-mediated AI workflows.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI security guidance, and structured threat-hunting methodologies.
* Experience developing security playbooks, API integrations, investigation workflows, or operational automation, including Cortex XSOAR where applicable.
* Windows or Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience working in a large enterprise, telecommunications, or similarly complex technical environment.
* Relevant security, incident response, cloud, automation, or AI security certifications

**What Success looks like:**

Success means reliable operation of assigned AI security capabilities, thorough and evidence-based investigations, effective detections, validated controls, useful documentation, and timely escalation of significant findings.

The Senior Information Security Engineer will turn program priorities into working technical capabilities and use operational findings to improve security coverage, investigative procedures, platform integrations, automation, and response.

The role will help build an AI Defense capability in which engineers understand why activity is suspicious, what evidence supports a conclusion, how existing controls address the threat, and when those controls are insufficient, rather than simply processing alerts.

Combining hands-on engineering with technical leadership, you will make sure these tools are secure, grounded in approved content and ready for business-critical use today.

  

**What you’ll bring**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with strong Python skills and a track record in API development, reusable libraries, distributed backend services and automated testing.
* At least 3 years of hands-on AI engineering experience with ChatGPT Enterprise and Databricks-based data retrieval, building secure, scalable AI solutions that meet enterprise standards.

* Experience implementing agent orchestration, tool calling, workflow state, retries, failure recovery and human approval mechanisms.
* Experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, production observability, incident investigation and operational support.

Job Description

**Senior Consultant – GenAI Developer (Snowflake Cortex)**

**Location**: Gurugram & Bangalore

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Senior GenAI Developer – Snowflake with 7–11 years of experience in Data/ML Engineering or Software Development, including 3–4 years of hands-on GenAI/LLM experience. The candidate will lead the architecture, design and development of production-ready GenAI solutions using Snowflake Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, Python and RAG frameworks.

The role involves leading the delivery of chatbots, copilots, document Q&A and summarisation solutions; defining RAG pipeline architecture; prompt engineering; LLM evaluation; and integrating AI solutions through APIs and Streamlit. The candidate will also guide technical decisions, mentor the team and engage directly with client stakeholders. Strong knowledge of Python, Snowflake, embeddings, vector/hybrid search and AI security/governance is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Gen AI Solution Development**

* Lead the design and build of enterprise-grade GenAI applications on Snowflake Cortex AI, including chatbots, copilots, summarisation tools and document Q&A.

* Use Cortex AI Functions (AISQL) such as AI\_COMPLETE, AI\_CLASSIFY, AI\_EXTRACT, AI\_SENTIMENT, AI\_FILTER, AI\_AGG and AI\_EMBED to enrich and analyse structured and unstructured data at scale.

* Architect and build RAG pipelines with Cortex Search, covering document parsing (AI\_PARSE\_DOCUMENT), chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid search and re-ranking.

* Develop natural-language-to-SQL experiences with Cortex Analyst, including authoring and tuning semantic models and semantic views.

* Build and configure Cortex Agents and Snowflake Intelligence agents that orchestrate across Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst and custom tools.

* Integrate Cortex capabilities into applications through the Cortex REST API, Python SDK and Streamlit in Snowflake.

**Data Engineering and Pipelines**

* Define data models, data quality standards and incremental refresh strategies for AI outputs, working with data engineers and architects.

**Quality, Cost and Governance**

* Write and version prompts, and choose the right model (for example Claude, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI or Snowflake Arctic) for accuracy, latency and cost.

* Set up evaluation for LLM outputs, including groundedness, relevance, hallucination checks and regression test sets, using tools such as Snowflake AI Observability or TruLens.

* Apply Cortex AI Guardrails, PII redaction (AI\_REDACT), role-based access control, masking policies and row access policies so that AI applications respect data security.

* Monitor credit consumption and query performance, and tune warehouses, batch sizes and model choice to keep costs predictable.

**Delivery and Collaboration**

* Translate business problems into GenAI use cases with clear success metrics, and shape solution roadmaps with client stakeholders.

* Own proofs of concept and their move into production releases with CI/CD, documentation and runbooks, including effort estimation and delivery planning.

* Present solutions, results and trade-offs to technical and senior business stakeholders.

* Lead and mentor a team of developers, run code and design reviews, and set reusable patterns and best practices across the team.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 7 to 11 years of total experience in ML engineering, data engineering or backend development.

* At least 3 to 4 years of hands-on GenAI or LLM work, with multiple solutions taken to production.

* Strong, hands-on experience with Snowflake Cortex AI: AISQL functions, Cortex Search and Cortex Analyst at a minimum. Cortex Agents experience is a strong plus.

* Strong Python skills, including Snowpark, pandas and REST API integration.

* Solid grasp of RAG: chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking and context window management.

* Prompt engineering skills: structured outputs (JSON), few-shot prompting, system prompts and prompt versioning.

* Experience evaluating LLM output quality and fixing hallucination, retrieval and grounding issues.

* Working knowledge of Snowflake security and governance: RBAC, masking policies and secure data sharing.

* Experience with Git and CI/CD for data or AI workloads (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins or similar).

* Proven experience leading small teams or workstreams, mentoring developers and owning end-to-end delivery.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort working directly with senior business users and clients.

**Good to Have**

* Snowflake certifications: SnowPro Core, SnowPro Advanced (Data Engineer or Architect), or the SnowPro Specialty GenAI certification.

* Experience with Document AI, Cortex Fine-tuning, Snowflake ML (Model Registry, Feature Store) or Snowpark Container Services.

* Familiarity with Cortex Code, Openflow, Snowflake Notebooks or the Snowflake MCP server.

* Exposure to other GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.

* Experience with dbt, Airflow or similar orchestration tools.

* Front-end skills for AI applications: Streamlit, React or similar.

* Domain knowledge in financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail or life sciences.

* Client-facing consulting or pre-sales experience, including building demos and estimating effort.

**Education**

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering or a related field. Equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.
